title: Print-safe rendering
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 10. Step 9 — Render the QR code; HCERT Specification, 4.2.2 QR 2D Barcode.

statements.label: Print-safe rendering
statements.requirement: Renderers SHALL scale modules by whole numbers of device pixels so that every module is square, SHALL emit a quiet zone of at least 4 modules, and SHOULD provide a helper that picks the scale for a target diagonal of 35 to 60 mm at a given dpi.

sources.quote: make sure each module is rendered as an exact square. Non-proportional scaling turns modules into rectangles
